Aalborg Universitetshospital Thisted is a hospital department operating under [[aalborg-universitetshospital|Aalborg Universitetshospital]] and is located within [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]]. It is systematically evaluated in the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) annual reports, which monitor clinical quality and treatment standards for atrial fibrillation patients across the Danish healthcare system.

In the reporting period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, the department's performance was tracked across several clinical quality indicators. For Indikator 1, the hospital successfully met the required standard, achieving a 96.0% compliance rate (95% CI: 91.6–98.5) [^src1]. However, for [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which measures the performance of echocardiography in newly diagnosed patients, the department recorded a compliance rate of 78.2% (95% CI: 72.0–83.6), falling short of the national standard [^src2].

The hospital's long-term treatment coverage was also evaluated under [[indikator-4a|Indikator 4a]], which measures anticoagulation therapy. In the two-year post-diagnosis analysis, 89.6% (95% CI: 80.6–95.4) of patients received treatment [^src3]. Notably, in the five-year analysis, Aalborg Universitetshospital Thisted achieved the highest compliance rate among all listed institutions at 93.4% (95% CI: 85.3–97.8), successfully meeting the ≥90% standard [^src5]. Additionally, the hospital is included in data regarding the incidence of heart failure following an atrial fibrillation diagnosis, reporting a rate of 6.0% (95% CI: 3.3–9.8) [^src6].
